extracted.name: Fajita Seasoning
extracted.description: This simple homemade fajita seasoning can be used in place of a store-bought packet, and it takes only 5 minutes to make! Your chicken or beef fajitas will taste amazing!
instruction_lines: Stir cornstarch, chili powder, salt, paprika, sugar, onion powder, garlic powder, cumin, and cayenne pepper together in a small bowl.
Use immediately in your favorite fajita recipe, or store in an airtight container in a cool, dry place for up to 6 months.
